characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: An Indian woman in her late 20s or early 30s with a slim build and a medium-dark complexion. She has long, voluminous, wavy black hair parted to the side. Her facial features are sharp and symmetrical, with large, expressive dark eyes, defined eyebrows, a straight nose, and full lips. She wears a small red bindi on her forehead.
characters.wardrobe: A crisp, white, long-sleeved collared shirt, a black pencil skirt, a delicate gold necklace with dark beads, and a simple bracelet on her right wrist.
characters.demeanor: Confident, friendly, and encouraging. She maintains direct eye contact with the camera and smiles frequently.

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: You know why you freeze when it is time to speak English?
Miss Nova says: Because you cannot learn to speak just by reading. You have to actually talk out loud.
Miss Nova says: But practicing with people is scary. You worry they will judge your mistakes.
Miss Nova says: I am Miss Nova, your personal AI teacher on Supernova AI. With me, you can make a thousand mistakes, and I will never laugh at you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook addresses the fear of speaking English
- Lands beat (c) You SPEAK instead of reading
- Lands beat (b) Privacy/no-judgement early
- Introduces Miss Nova by name

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: I do not give everyone the same boring lessons.
Miss Nova says: I analyze your exact level and build a personalized plan just for you.
Miss Nova says: We practice real-life situations together, like your next job interview or a client call.
Miss Nova says: And when you get stuck, I explain the logic right in your own language, so you actually understand.
